get_vc_model_and_transform: get a pretrained VC model, its transform, and embedding dimension by model name
get_vc_model_with_compression: get a VC model configured with a compression layer enabled for feature extraction
list_available_vc_models: list all available VC model names from the vc_models model zoo registry
load_vc_model_config: load and parse a VC model YAML configuration file using OmegaConf
get_vc_model_for_device: get a VC model and transform loaded onto a specified CPU or GPU device
